name: Amy's perfect candy
source:
Amy is not allowed to eat candy until she is 7, but this year she is finally 7 and ready to hunt all the candies from her neighborhood! She is very determined on finding 'the perfect candy' during the hunt, but sweets are sweeter when shared with others!

Will Amy find her 'perfect candy'?

[From [url=https://rossaredflyn.itch.io/amys-perfect-candy]itch.io[/url]]
